title.narrative: Multi-Sectoral Emergency Response in Agriculture, WASH, Protection, and CASH Assistance for Drought-Affected Community of Zabagazo Woreda in SWER.

description.narrative:
ltpgtlt/pgtltp style="text-align:justifyline-height:150%"gtAccording to WFP Regional Drought Response Plan for the Horn of Africa (January – December 2023), the humanitarian crisis in the Horn of Africa is expanding and deepening.ltspan style="color:#4A4A4A"gt lt/spangtCombined with insecurity and macroeconomic volatility, the impact of the drought on food and nutrition security has been devastating. Across Ethiopia, Kenya, and Somalia, an estimated 22 million people are now acutely food insecure because of the drought. The malnutrition situation is also critical. Some 5.1 million children across drought-affected areas of the three countries are acutely malnourished in 2023, with dire implications for their health, growth, and survival. lt/pgt
ltp style="text-align:justifyline-height:150%"gtAccording to IOM's 2023 drought response plan for Ethiopia, Communities in southern and northeastern parts of Ethiopia are suffering from a devastating drought following four consecutive failed rainy seasons since late 2020. This is the worst drought in forty years. The drought is worsening in scope and scale and is increasingly affecting more areas. According to Dawuro zone Multisectoral assessment, 3,200 pregnant mothers, 1,645 lactating mothers, and 3705 under-five children are the most vulnerable particularly in Zebagazo woreda only while the number of food insecure community who needs urgent support amounts to 44,552. Moreover, due to the drought, 1228 animals died while 2,767 students were forced to drop out, and also 503 Children are affected by malnutrition. According to Dawuro Zone women’s affairs office protection is the major issue that should have to pay enough attention to reduce exacerbating risks most recently we received 4 abductions, 5 rape, 65 FGM, and early child marriage in Zabagazo woreda. lt/pgt
ltp style="text-align:justifyline-height:150%"gtThus, AEID in partnership with EDA plans to support the drought-affected community of Zebagazo woreda of Dauro Zone in SWER. AEID and EDA will leverage their experience in humanitarian and development interventions in the area. The proposed project will support the affected community in the agriculture, WASH, and protection sectors.
